name: omarock: multi-source mpd music player
author: Marc Ewing
description: A multi-source mpd-based music player. Supports your local music files, internet radio, Spotify, SiriusXM, and Apple Music (through a live bridge running on your Mac). The last three are optional, and require accounts. Drive with keyboard or mouse. Bar shows cover and song, click for compact and expanded panes.

barWidget.description: Cover, artist and song, and a panel with the queue, search, playlists and sources for mpd.

schema.label: Internet radio
schema.description: Stations from Radio Browser, played by mpd. Nothing to set up.

schema.label: Your US state
schema.description: For the radio's local stations: a state's name, such as Maine.

schema.label: Spotify
schema.description: Needs Spotify Premium and the omarock-spotify service (spotify/README.md).

schema.label: Apple Music
schema.description: Needs the omarock bridge on a Mac (bridge/README.md).

schema.label: SiriusXM
schema.description: Needs a SiriusXM subscription and the omarock-sxm service (sxm/README.md). Unofficial.
